description: This dashboard works with postgres_exporter for prometheus

panels.title: General Counters, CPU, Memory and File Descriptor Stats

panels.description: Virtual and Resident memory size in bytes, averages over 5 min interval
panels.title: Average Memory Usage

targets.expr: topk(5, rate(cnpg_pg_stat_statements_block_read_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", pod="$instance"}[15m])) * on(queryid, pod) group_left(query) cnpg_pg_stat_statements_query_id

panels.title: Top queries by seconds spent reading

targets.expr: topk(5, rate(cnpg_pg_stat_statements_block_read_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", pod="$instance"}[15m])) * on(queryid, pod) group_left(query) cnpg_pg_stat_statements_query_id

panels.title: Top queries by seconds spent reading

targets.expr: topk(10, rate( cnpg_pg_stat_statements_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", pod="$instance"} [5m])) * on(queryid, pod) group_left(query) cnpg_pg_stat_statements_query_id
topk(10, rate( cnpg_pg_stat_statements_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", pod="$instance"} [5m])) * on(queryid, pod) group_left(query) cnpg_pg_stat_statements_query_id
topk(10, rate(cnpg_pg_stat_statements_block_write_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", pod="$instance"}[5m])) * on(queryid, pod) group_left(query) cnpg_pg_stat_statements_query_id

panels.title: Top queries by time spent writing

targets.expr: topk(10, rate(cnpg_pg_stat_statements_block_write_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", pod="$instance"}[5m])) * on(queryid, pod) group_left(query) cnpg_pg_stat_statements_query_id

panels.title: Top queries by time spent writing

targets.expr: topk(10, rate(cnpg_pg_stat_statements_calls_total{namespace="$namespace", pod="$instance"}[15m])) * on(queryid, pod) group_left(query) cnpg_pg_stat_statements_query_id
topk(10, rate(cnpg_pg_stat_statements_calls_total{namespace="$namespace", pod="$instance"}[15m])) * on(queryid, pod) group_left(query) cnpg_pg_stat_statements_query_id
pg_stat_activity_count{datname=~"$datname", pod="$instance", state=~"idle|idle in transaction|idle in transaction (aborted)"}
